# American Legacy Contracting

> Licensed general contractor in Payson, Utah serving Utah County. Specializing in basement finishing, kitchen and bathroom remodels, new construction, and handyman services.

## About

Alan Barben is the owner of American Legacy Contracting. He is fully licensed and insured in Utah and holds a Bachelor's degree and an Applied Science degree in Construction Management. He has 14+ years of experience in residential and commercial construction, including framing, electrical, HVAC, and plumbing. BuildZoom ranks American Legacy Contracting in the top 1% of general contractors in Utah, above 74,376 other contractors.

## Services

- Basement Finishing — turning unfinished basements into livable square footage (bedrooms, family rooms, home offices)
- Kitchen & Bathroom Remodels — full renovations and updates throughout Utah County
- New Construction — custom home builds and new residential construction
- Handyman Services — home maintenance, repairs, and small projects; also coordinates vetted electricians and plumbers

## Service Area

Payson, Spanish Fork, Salem, Springville, Mapleton, Elk Ridge, and surrounding Utah County communities in Utah.
